How We Met

Our Love Story

◆

Some love stories unfold slowly, while others feel written long before they begin. Ours started on an ordinary Saturday in Charleston — two strangers reaching for the same bunch of eucalyptus — and somehow, from that very first hello, neither of us has stopped talking since.

Memory Lane

September 2021
First Meet

A crowded morning at the Charleston farmers market, one bunch of eucalyptus left, and two hands reaching for it at the same moment. Liam insisted Emma take it — then found three more stalls to walk her past, just to keep the conversation going.

March 2022
Fell In Love

Spring arrived, and so did a hundred small certainties: Sunday calls that lasted hours, a shared umbrella in a King Street downpour, and the quiet realisation that home had quietly become a person.

August 2022
First Date

Our first official date — a picnic beneath the live oaks, sweet tea, and a sunset over the harbour that neither of us watched, because we were far too busy looking at each other.

February 2024
First Kiss

On a cold February evening along the Battery, with the harbour lights coming on one by one, Liam finally found the courage. Emma likes to say it was worth every day of the wait.

November 2026
Engaged

Back beneath the same live oaks where they picnicked on their first date, Liam went down on one knee with his grandmother's ring. Through happy tears, Emma said the easiest yes of her life.

September 2027
Wedding Day

And now, the best chapter yet. On September 18, 2027, surrounded by everyone we love, we say “I do” — and this time, you are part of the story.

Note on Gifts

Your presence at our wedding truly is the greatest gift of all. However, if you wish to honour us with a gift, we have put together a small registry to make it easy — and a wishing well will also be available at the reception for cards and contributions toward our honeymoon.

Good to Know

Questions & Answers

◆

Wedding Information

The dress code is garden formal: long dresses, suits, and jackets are warmly encouraged, and we would love you to incorporate sage and garden tones. The ceremony is held on the lawn, so we suggest block heels, wedges, or dressy flats rather than stilettos.

Please plan to arrive 20 to 30 minutes early. Guest arrival begins at 4:30 PM and the ceremony starts promptly at 5:00 PM, so a little extra time lets you park, find your seat, and settle in without any rush.

For anything at all before the day, write to us at hello@liamandemma.com and we will happily help. On the day itself, our welcome team and wedding coordinator will be on hand at the gardens to answer questions so the couple can simply enjoy the celebration.

Willow Creek Gardens is at 123 Magnolia Lane, Charleston, SC 29401. Open the Details page and tap “View Venue Location” for a map and step-by-step directions from wherever you are travelling.

The ceremony begins at 5:00 PM, followed by cocktails, dinner, toasts, and dancing, and the evening closes with our send-off and farewell at 10:00 PM. The shuttle keeps running until midnight for guests who would like to linger a little longer.

The celebration goes ahead rain or shine. Willow Creek Gardens has a beautiful covered pavilion and terrace ready as our weather plan, so the ceremony and reception will move under cover if the weather turns — same day, same time, same celebration.

Accommodation & Travel

We have reserved a block of rooms at three Charleston hotels: The Magnolia House Hotel in the historic district, Harbour View Inn on East Bay Street, and The Garden District Lodge near the venue. You will find all three, with booking links, on the Details page.

As soon as you can. Charleston is popular in September and rooms go quickly; our wedding block is held until August 18, 2027. Mention “Liam & Emma” when booking to receive the wedding rate.

Yes. A shuttle departs The Magnolia House Hotel at 4:00 PM on the wedding day and runs between the hotel and the gardens throughout the evening, returning hourly from 9:00 PM until midnight, so nobody needs to worry about driving.

All three are close by: The Garden District Lodge is about five minutes from the gardens, The Magnolia House Hotel about ten minutes, and Harbour View Inn about fifteen minutes, depending on traffic.

Yes, both. Complimentary self-parking and valet service are available at the garden entrance from 4:00 PM on the day, and our welcome team will point you in the right direction when you arrive.

Charleston is made for a wedding weekend: stroll the historic district and Rainbow Row, walk the Battery at sunset, browse the shops on King Street, or take a harbour tour. If you are staying longer, the front desk at each hotel has a list of our favourite local spots.

Guest Questions

As much as we adore your little ones, our celebration is adults-only, unless your children are named on your invitation. We hope this gives parents a well-deserved evening out to relax and celebrate with us.

Because the gardens have limited space, plus-ones are warmly welcomed only when they are named on your invitation. If you are unsure whether yours includes one, just write to us at hello@liamandemma.com and we will be happy to check.

Please send your reply by August 21, 2027 using the RSVP page. Final numbers go to our caterers shortly after that date, so a timely reply really does help us plan a wonderful evening for everyone.

Life happens, and we completely understand. If your plans change after you have replied, please tell us as soon as possible at hello@liamandemma.com so we can adjust seating and catering — the sooner we know, the easier it is.

If you are running late, please slip in quietly and take a seat at the back of the ceremony lawn; our ushers will guide you. Once the ceremony has ended you are very welcome to join everyone fully for cocktail hour and the rest of the celebration.

Our welcome team will greet you at the garden entrance, help with parking or the valet, and show you to the ceremony lawn, where you can help yourself to a cool drink and find your seat before the music begins.
